headline: Donor-aware statistical models extract disease and genetic signal beyond mean gene expression
label: Population Scale Expression Modeling
summary: New methods model donor-level variance, isoform diversity, and cell-type-specific genetics to resolve disease-associated expression in large single-cell and spatial cohorts.
synthesis: The dominant thread is modeling expression variation at population scale while respecting donor structure, moving past mean gene-level abundance. SAIGE-QTL applies a Poisson mixed model to single-cell counts for eQTL mapping, and ATTICUS uses uncertainty-aware personalised prediction for cell-type TWAS. IDC contrasts within-donor gene covariance between cases and controls, TailEnrich tests distribution tails for subset-specific dysregulation, and TriSCOPE combines predictive modeling with donor-aware differential expression across ~4.2M nuclei from 627 donors in Alzheimer's disease. Isoform diversity, quantified with Shannon evenness across 4,814 GTEx samples, is proposed as a distinct expression dimension. Spatial methods, MorphoANOVA and GeneSPOT, link histology to expression and quantify gene-relationship reorganization across conditions and time.
